summary: child_environment() now inherits the user's environment (PATH, HOME, USER, SHELL, TMPDIR, locale, git/ssh settings) instead of a fixed PATH=/usr/bin:/bin + C.UTF-8 set, so cargo/npm/brew resolve in run_command, ripgrep, extensions and project git. Secret-bearing variables are dropped by is_secret_environment_name: ASCII-uppercased name contains KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, PASSWD, CREDENTIAL, AUTH, COOKIE or JWT, except agent sockets SSH_AUTH_SOCK and GPG_AGENT_INFO. Non-UTF-8 entries are skipped; PATH and LANG fall back to defaults when absent.
notes: Builds used the shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/mac/Github/zenpi/target with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. The shared target dir served a stale zenpi lib built from another checkout (E0432 on the new export) until src/lib.rs was touched; worktrees sharing one target dir should touch sources or expect this. Fragment matching is deliberately broad (e.g. MONKEY_PATH would be dropped); a false positive only hides a variable from children.
